title: TNT Sulfur Cubes
description: Allows sulfur cubes to absorb TNT and explode on impact!
body:
# TNT Sulfur Cubes - Youly

![TNT Sulfur Cubes - Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fedcfe7c6a071a5e4a6d89423017c82e33ba52e3.png)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 📇 PRESENTATION

This datapack allows sulfur cubes to absorb TNT, which causes them to explode upon impact against a wall, floor or ceiling.

This can be useful if you want to play with TNT that you can push or launch.

This feature is very requested by the community, this datapack is made for that!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ✨ FEATURES

## Launch TNT on other mobs or players!

![TNT Sulfur Cubes - Launch TNT sulfur cube](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0867747a71b6c02d3d7d3d256c07dd4ce821a7c.gif)

## Leashed TNT sulfur cubes don't trigger, carry them with a happy ghast!

![TNT Sulfur Cubes - Happy Ghast carrying TNT sulfur cubes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25b54c80254760bdaf9c55d643aec05e6200d7eb_0.webp)

## TNT sulfur cubes can trigger a chain reaction!

![TNT Sulfur Cubes - Exploding TNT causing a chain reaction on TNT sulfur cubes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e7825bc56beb7f14fe32c3cb787ef9a457307ba.gif)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 📜 INSTRUCTIONS

### How to get a TNT sulfur cube :

Drop a TNT block or interact with TNT on a sulfur cube to make it absorb.

### How to uninstall the datapack :
Execute this command in chat (Operators only)
```
/function tnt_sulfur_cube:uninstall
```
Remaining TNT sulfur cubes will keep their TNT but they won't be able to explode.
